en: When the President vetoes a bill, Congress can still make it a law if two-thirds of both houses vote to override the veto.
Andres Bonifacio tore his cedulas to signal the start of the Philippine Revolution because the tax certificates represented Spanish colonial oppression.
The Supreme Court declares a law unconstitutional when it conflicts with the 1987 Constitution, thereby preventing the legislative branch from enforcing invalid rules.
Lucban residents decorate their houses with kiping leaves every May because the Pahiyas Festival honors San Isidro Labrador for a bountiful harvest.
The Ifugao people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces into mountains because the steep slopes required flat, stepped irrigation channels to successfully grow rice.
Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator because rural clinics lacked electricity, and the bamboo material maintained a safe temperature using warm water.
Filipino citizens register with the COMELEC to exercise their right to vote, which allows them to elect leaders during national elections.
Spain ceded the Philippines to the United States in the 1898 Treaty of Paris because Spain lost the Spanish-American War.
Ancient Filipinos carved Baybayin characters on bamboo using sharp knives because the hard plant material preserved the writing better than fragile leaves.
Neighbors physically carry a nipa hut to a new location during a bayanihan because the traditional house is lightweight and built on sturdy wooden poles.
The House of Representatives initiates an impeachment complaint against the President, which then triggers a trial in the Senate to decide removal.
Jose Rizal's execution by firing squad sparked the Philippine Revolution because his martyrdom united the Filipinos against Spanish colonial abuses.
